housing.summary: Adelaide is one of Australia's more affordable capital cities. A 1-bedroom apartment in the city centre typically rents for approximately AUD 350–450 per week. South Australia's Residential Tenancies Act caps the bond at 4 weeks rent. Primary rental portals are realestate.com.au and domain.com.au.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Australia, new arrivals typically need a valid passport, proof of Australian address, and a Tax File Number (TFN). CommBank allows account opening up to 14 days before arrival. ANZ and NAB also serve new residents.
required_docs: Valid passport (original required for in-branch ID verification within 20 days)

schools.summary: Adelaide has international schools offering IB and other curricula. The national school directory myschool.edu.au lists all South Australian schools. State schools fall under the SA Department for Education.

legal_admin.summary: Visa holders in Australia must notify the Department of Home Affairs of any address changes. New residents should register with myGov (my.gov.au) to link ATO, Medicare, and Centrelink services.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register with myGov; notify Home Affairs of address changes

tax_finance.summary: All workers and income earners in Australia require a Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO). Apply online for free at ato.gov.au.

transport.summary: Adelaide public transport is operated by Adelaide Metro using the Metrocard (or contactless payments). The network covers buses, trains, and trams. A 28-day (monthly) Metrocard pass price is not retrievable from currently accessible pages. Overseas licence holders must convert to an SA licence via Service SA. Medicare registration via Services Australia.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Overseas licence holders must convert to an SA driver's licence via Service SA. Typically required within 3 months of taking up SA residency.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible visa holders enrol in Medicare at Services Australia offices or online via servicesaustralia.gov.au/medicare.
